details:
Since the Unity 6 update, VRChat on Quest standalone has been experiencing random black screens and repeated client crashes.

There does not appear to be a consistent trigger. This has happened in different worlds during normal use, including when no avatars are actively loading.

There appear to be two failure behaviors:

1. Black screen / recovery / forced recenter

- VRChat suddenly goes black.

- The image may return after a short period.

- When it returns, VRChat sometimes forcibly recenters/reorients my view in a different direction even though I did not manually recenter.

- This can happen repeatedly.

- Eventually VRChat may completely stop functioning. The display remains black, all VRChat audio stops, and my microphone stops transmitting to other users.

- At that point VRChat does not recover and must be restarted.

2. Complete crash to Horizon OS

- VRChat sometimes completely crashes without warning.

- I am immediately dropped out of VRChat into Quest passthrough/the Horizon OS menu.

- This can happen repeatedly during a play session.

- The Quest itself remains operational and responsive after VRChat crashes.

The crashes appear random and are not isolated to a particular world or avatar. I have observed them while simply using VRChat normally with no avatars actively loading.

These problems began after the VRChat Unity 6 update.

Reproduction:

1. Launch VRChat on Quest standalone.

2. Join a world and use VRChat normally.

3. After an unpredictable amount of time, one of the above failures may occur.

I have not found a reliable action that reproduces the issue on demand.
title: Quest Standalone Random Black Screens, Forced Recentering, and Repeated Crashes to Horizon OS After Unity 6 Update
